card.name: Throwing something out or away
card.fires_on: The verb throw (thrown, throwing) or the object right after it, when the next word is likely out or away. Also hands/hand in body-position phrases.

modes.label: Throw out/away
modes.description: The word throw or its object when discarding something, where out or away comes next.
modes.example: the patient should<< throw>> out the rest of the pack and start

modes.label: Thrown or thrown runner
modes.description: Throw used for physically hurling or ejecting someone or something.
modes.example: catcher Fohl<< threw>> the runner out easily.

modes.label: Hand in body phrases
modes.description: The word hand or hands in descriptions of holding or binding.
modes.example: blindfolded,<< hands>> crossed behind your back and tied, wearing

card.plain: It lights up on the word throw when something is being thrown out or away, such as used patches or leftover pills.
